The man thanks you again for transporting the wood on such short notice. “Sorry we never get formally acquainted, my name is Fred Marks, I am the owner of Marks Construction,,,The only business that still builds log houses” he adds trying to be professional. “Well, I did a background check on you and there is some disturbing stuff on you. I need you to transport more wood to <DST>, but just for safety sakes I will send one of my fighters to follow you. But that will cost you 50,000 credits. You will still get 250,000. Agreed?”
